role: Declares OvernightReportRenderer, a stateless value wrapping a PDFReportGenerator that draws the overnight HR chart, overnight stats card and tags/notes block of the recovery PDF; exposes three forwarded primitives from the generator.
types: OvernightReportRenderer: struct — overnight-page renderer built on demand by PDFReportGenerator.overnight; holds the generator strongly
toplevel: Stored property `generator`; memberwise init used by PDFReportGenerator.overnight (PDFReportGenerator+OvernightForwarding.swift:13).

units.does: Computed property returning generator.config (page size, margins, fonts, colours) for the renderer's drawing code.
Forwards a section heading draw to PDFReportGenerator.drawSectionHeading and returns the y below it (yPosition+20).
Forwards a compact stat box draw to PDFReportGenerator.drawCompactStatBox, which itself forwards to ReportSectionRenderer.drawCompactStatBox.
